declarations.description:
Grid of resizable panes. The children are `c2-dash-card` elements, placed by their `col`/`row` attributes; each
one draws drag handles on the edges it shares with a neighbour, and dragging one resizes the whole track, so the
cards on either side stay aligned. `columns` and `rows` take a track count (`columns="3"` is three equal columns)
or an explicit track list (`columns="320px 1fr"`); a track is switched to pixels the first time it is dragged, and
the `fr` tracks around it give up the space in proportion to their weight, down to the minimums. With a
`storage-key` the sizes survive a reload.

The grid is the sizing authority: a card never sets its own width. Give the element a height (or place it in a
flex/grid parent that does) whenever the rows use `fr`, since the row tracks divide the host's height.
declarations.name: Dashboard

cssProperties.description: Gutter between the cards. The drag handles sit inside the cards, so a gutter under ~6px is hard to grab.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dashboard--gap

cssProperties.description: Inset around the tracks. With a `background` it is what turns the gutters into a visible frame between the panes.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dashboard--padding

slots.description: The `c2-dash-card` panes. Anything else becomes an ordinary grid item, placed by your own CSS.

members.name: columns
members.description: Column count (`3`) or an explicit track list (`'320px 1fr'`). Each entry must be one simple size.

members.name: rows
members.description: Row count (`2`) or an explicit track list (`'auto 1fr'`).

members.name: minColumnWidth
members.description: Floor for every column, in pixels. A card's own `min-width` raises it for the tracks that card covers.

members.name: minRowHeight
members.description: Floor for every row, in pixels. A card's own `min-height` raises it for the tracks that card covers.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: `localStorage` key the track sizes are stored under. Without it the grid starts from the authored tracks.

members.name: layout
members.description:
Placement overrides keyed by the cards' `card-id`, for a layout that is chosen at runtime rather than authored
in the markup. Each entry wins over the card's own `col`/`row`/`col-span`/`row-span`/visibility.

members.name: pixelCache
members.description: Used track sizes, valid until the next write to the tracks.

members.name: columnSizes
members.description: Column tracks as they are laid out right now.

members.name: rowSizes
members.description: Row tracks as they are laid out right now.

members.name: reset
members.description: Back to the authored tracks, and the stored ones are forgotten.

members.name: splitterValue
members.description:
Where the splitter after `index` sits, as a percentage of the tracks' total. A focusable `separator` is a
window splitter, and a window splitter has to report a value.

members.name: trackPixels
members.description:
Reading a used track size forces layout, and a drag asks for it from every card's handles on every pointer
move. The answer cannot change until something writes to the DOM, so it is cached until one of them does.

members.name: freeSpace
members.description: What is left of the host along `axis` once the tracks, the gutters and the padding have taken their share.

members.name: trackMin
members.description: The largest minimum any card covering this track asks for, spread over the tracks that card spans.

events.name: layout-change
events.description: The track sizes changed and the gesture ended. Does not bubble: listen on the element.

declarations.description:
One pane of a `c2-dashboard`. It owns its place in the grid (`col`, `row`, `col-span`, `row-span`), the drag
handles on the edges it shares with a neighbour, and the optional expand controls; it draws no surface of its
own, so put a `c2-card` — or any markup — in the default slot.

A handle resizes the whole grid track, never just this card, and it only appears where there is a neighbour to
take the space from: the right edge has one when another column follows, the left edge when one precedes. Drag
it, or focus it and use the arrow keys (10px a step, 1px with Shift).

Filling the `header`, `actions` or `footer` slot turns on that row; with the header and actions both empty the
expand controls float over the top-right corner of the pane instead. An expanded card covers its neighbours, so
give it — or the card inside it — a background.

Every built-in icon is a slot whose fallback is the default drawing, so a pane can use the host application's own
icon set without giving up the behaviour.
declarations.name: DashCard

cssProperties.description: `hidden` keeps the content inside the track; switch it to `visible` for a pane that has to overflow, such as one holding a menu.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card--overflow

cssProperties.description: Fill while the card is expanded over its neighbours; falls back to `--c2-dash-card--background`, which is transparent, so set one of the two.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card__expanded--background

cssProperties.description: Length of the scale-in the card plays when it expands or collapses. Ignored under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card__expanded--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Inset of the floating control group from the top-right corner, used only while the header row is off.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card__controls--offset

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the grab area on an edge. It reaches into the pane, so it stays grabbable however wide the grid gutter is.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card__handle--size

cssProperties.description: Gap between the handle's visible bar and the ends of the edge.
cssProperties.name: --c2-dash-card__handle--inset

cssParts.description: The header row, or the floating control group when the header and actions slots are empty.
cssParts.name: header

cssParts.description: The wrapper around the default slot.
cssParts.name: body

cssParts.description: The group holding the `controls` slot and the built-in expand buttons.
cssParts.name: controls

cssParts.description: Every drag handle. Each also carries the part of its edge.
cssParts.name: handle

cssParts.description: The handle on the left edge.
cssParts.name: handle-left

cssParts.description: The handle on the right edge.

cssParts.description: The handle on the top edge.

cssParts.description: The handle on the bottom edge.

slots.description: Pane content. Give it `height: 100%` (a `c2-card` already stretches) so it follows the row track.
Title area of the header row; filling it turns the row on.
slots.name: header

slots.description: Your own controls at the end of the header row, before the built-in expand buttons and separated from them by `--c2-dash-card__actions--gap`.
slots.name: actions

slots.name: controls

slots.name: footer

members.description: 1-based column the card starts in.

members.description: 1-based row the card starts in.

members.name: colSpan
members.description: Number of columns the card occupies.

members.name: rowSpan
members.description: Number of rows the card occupies.

members.name: minWidth
members.description: Smallest width in pixels the card accepts; it raises the minimum of every column it covers.

members.name: minHeight
members.description: Smallest height in pixels the card accepts; it raises the minimum of every row it covers.

members.name: resize
members.description: Which edges carry a drag handle.

members.name: expandWidth
members.description: Offers a control that expands the card across every column.

members.name: expandHeight
members.description: Offers a control that expands the card across every row.

members.name: expandFull
members.description: Offers a control that expands the card over the whole grid.

members.name: expanded
members.description: How far the card is currently expanded. Settable, so an app can expand a card from its own control.

members.name: constraint
members.description: The grid reads this during a drag; a hidden card asks for nothing.

members.name: hostChanged
members.description: Called by the grid when its shape or its layout record changed.

members.name: syncHandleValues
members.description:
The splitter values are written straight onto the handles rather than re-rendered: a drag changes them on
every pointer move, and nothing else about the card changes with them.

members.name: attachToDashboard
members.description:
The grid may upgrade after its cards do — the card element is in the document either way, so find it and wait
for the definition rather than for a parent that is already alive.

events.name: expand-change
events.description: The card was expanded or collapsed through one of its own controls. Does not bubble: listen on the element.
